title: Git stored credentials
whyItMatters: The Git store credential helper keeps plaintext logins for remote repositories. Anyone with the disk could reuse them.
notes: Only applies when the store helper is in use; Windows Credential Manager helpers are covered by the credentials rules instead.

cleanup.signOut: Revoke the personal access tokens this machine used at your Git host, such as GitHub, so the stored logins stop working.
steps: Revoke the tokens at the Git host.
Delete the file named in the plan if it is still there.
Check with the host whether the machine ever had push access to anything you still use.
cleanup.risk: Deletes the stored Git logins on this PC. Tokens that are not revoked at the host keep working until they expire.
